category_edits.rationale: Across all four datasets, jointly reduce maximum history length to 64 and learning rate to 6e-4. Shorter attention reduces computation while the lower learning rate may stabilize optimization with truncated context. Existing checkpoint metadata and predictor construction propagate MAXLEN consistently. Preserve all other model, feature, loss and training settings.

change_summary: Jointly set MAXLEN=64 and LR=6e-4 for all four category models; existing metadata keeps predictor shapes consistent.
